artist_reel_line: A Saturday at the Grove and a Sunday after midnight; Mardi Gras weekends at Tipitina's since.
Thursday after dark in the Galaxy Barn; the surprise album Snakes & Ladders in 2026.
One Thursday evening at Cherry Hill; Is It Now? in 2025, and the farm again in 2026.
Saturday and Sunday on the farm; later Rounder Records, and a Texas headline run.
One Friday afternoon at the Windmill; Golliwog in 2025, then Japan and Australia.
Curation with chefs on Saturday, Cherry Hill that night; then a tour with Yo La Tengo.
Thursday at Cherry Hill, Friday in the Woods; then My Light, My Destroyer on Dead Oceans.
Back three years on, a Grammy winner now; Thursday at the Paddock, Sunday in the Woods.
A late Thursday at Cherry Hill, a Saturday at the Lucky Barn; later Third Man Records.
A Friday at the Grove, a Sunday at the Galaxy Barn; Careful! on Sub Pop a year later.
On the farm in 2022.
One Friday afternoon at the Windmill; REVELATOR on Fat Possum in 2024, then Snakes & Ladders.
A late Friday at Cherry Hill, then the Galaxy Barn; Weirdo in 2025, and a Mercury shortlist.
A Saturday at the Windmill, a Sunday at the Galaxy Barn; later, Laena Myers on her own.
Saturday night at the Paddock; Underdressed at the Symphony in 2024, then the real one.
A Friday night in the Woods and a Saturday after midnight; a reunion of alumni in 2026.
A Saturday at the Lucky Barn, Sunday at Cherry Hill; then separate roads back to the 78s.
A Friday at midnight in the Galaxy Barn, a Saturday at the Grove; then Trash Classic.
Cherry Hill on a Friday night, the Paddock on Saturday; then the Final Chamber tour.
A Saturday at the Galaxy Barn, a Sunday at the Lucky Barn; The Hometown Kid in the same year.
A Saturday at the Galaxy Barn and a Sunday at the Grove; Union Pool in Brooklyn, 2026.
One Sunday afternoon in the Woods; in fall 2026, amphitheaters in Los Angeles and Austin.
Friday in the Woods, Saturday near midnight in the Galaxy Barn; a second Sub Pop record.
Back after six years: Friday in the Woods, Saturday at Cherry Hill; then a live album.
A Saturday at the Galaxy Barn and a Sunday at the Grove; late 2026, theaters in Mexico.
A Thursday night at the Galaxy Barn and a Friday at the Lucky Barn; the seventh Pickathon.
Friday at the Lucky Barn, Saturday noon at the Grove; The Old Beloved Path in 2026.
A Thursday afternoon at the Grove; Portland to New Orleans, and From Newman Street in 2025.
After midnight at the Paddock, Friday evening at the Grove; then I Killed Your Dog.
A Saturday in the Woods and a Sunday at the Galaxy Barn; Thx back on vinyl in 2025.
Three sets, from the Paddock to the Lucky Barn; then Valley of Heart's Delight.
A Thursday at the Windmill, a Friday at the Lucky Barn; Hillsboro's festival in 2026.
Thursday night at Cherry Hill, Friday morning at the Windmill; later an engineer at home.
Second visit: the Paddock Thursday, the Grove Friday. Then the Opry, and the name Silverada.
An Edge session in 2022; a full set on the farm in 2023.
Saturday near midnight in the Woods, Sunday evening at the Paddock; then North Sea Jazz.
Friday in the Woods, after midnight at Cherry Hill; Odyssey in 2024, then a Tiny Desk.
Friday after midnight in the Galaxy Barn, Sunday at the Windmill; Four Singles in 2024.
A Friday evening at Cherry Hill, Sunday at the Galaxy Barn; Desert Queen in 2025.
Saturday in the Woods, Sunday after midnight at the Grove; Dancing While Falling in 2023.
A Friday at noon at the Grove, Saturday at the Windmill; Kissing Other ppl in 2025.
Thursday afternoon at the Grove, Friday at Cherry Hill; a solo album on Oh Boy in 2026.
Friday night at the Galaxy Barn, Sunday in the Woods; Bite Down on Merge in 2024.
A Saturday at the Galaxy Barn, a Sunday at Cherry Hill; then Emerging Act of the Year.
Saturday near midnight at the Paddock, Sunday in the Woods; Nu Zamrock in 2026.
After midnight at the Paddock, Sunday at Cherry Hill; the quartet then ended its run.
Saturday at Cherry Hill, Sunday night in the Galaxy Barn; clubs across the US into 2026.
Friday at the Galaxy Barn, Sunday at the Grove; Good Living Is Coming for You, a year later.
Past midnight Thursday, Friday night at Cherry Hill; Cartoons due November 27, 2026.
A Saturday morning at the Windmill and a Sunday night in the Galaxy Barn; back in 2026.
Second visit, three years on, a Grammy nominee between; later more IBMA awards.
Saturday at Cherry Hill, Sunday after midnight at the Paddock; then Got a Story to Tell.
Thursday after midnight at Cherry Hill, Friday at the Galaxy Barn; Horses in 2025.
Eight years on, a Grammy nominee: Saturday in the Woods, Sunday at the Paddock.
Three years on: Friday in the Woods, Sunday at the Grove; now Viv and Riley.
One Friday night at the Paddock; in February 2023, two Grammys and two Brit Awards.
A Friday afternoon at the Windmill; Acadia on Nonesuch in 2024.
On the farm in 2022.
